name: radial-context-menu
title: Radial Context Menu
description: A circular action ring that manifests instantly around pointer coordinates on context-click or trigger press.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Coordinate Pie Invocation: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
